timeline.event: constructor draft written but not executed

evidence: The selection artifact was emitted after viability.
The independent collision gate was upgraded and passed.
Source reading and a 5,572-byte constructor script were completed.
The constructor script contains proposed sources, semantics, families, and configuration for all three entries.

cause.primary: The lane treated construction as a single late commit: it completed source selection and drafted the entire three-entry constructor before executing any compile. The draft itself landed 17.528 seconds after the construction deadline.
cause.controlFailure: No early-start checkpoint required observable construction execution while sufficient construction budget remained. The first construction-phase gate evaluation occurred only 40.856 seconds after its deadline.
contributingFactors: The upgraded collision gate completed at elapsed 134.524 seconds, leaving 195.476 seconds to the construction cutoff.
The remaining interval was spent serially reading sources and composing a full constructor rather than emitting an early execution receipt.
The review gate correctly waited for a construction manifest; it did not prevent construction. The missing artifact was caused upstream because the constructor never ran.

watchdogProposal.name: fail-closed early construction-start watchdog

requiredCheckpoints.requirement: Selection and collision gate sealed; exact constructor ownership assigned.
At least one real constructor execution or dry compile has started and emitted a timestamped receipt tied to the selected IDs.
At least one compiled fresh product exists, or the cohort terminates immediately as NO_START with its partial work quarantined.

failClosedRules: A source-reading note or unexecuted script does not count as construction start.
Construction start requires an observable process/receipt: command start UTC, selected IDs, input hashes, and output target.
If the 210-second receipt is absent, stop expanding the draft and execute the smallest valid compile slice immediately.
If no product exists at 270 seconds, seal the terminal before the 330-second cutoff; do not spend the remaining minute polishing an unexecuted batch.
Review and correction clocks may not borrow time to rescue a missed construction start.
watchdogProposal.recommendedBatchBehavior: Compile one entry as soon as its bounded dossier is complete, then continue the remaining entries. The manifest may be finalized after all products, but construction-start evidence must exist early.
